I’d like the app-held copy to be created automatically when I save a bookmark, so preserving the page doesn’t depend on me remembering another step. It should be kept as a single self-contained page file. Saving to the Internet Archive can remain a separate, manual choice because that sends the page to an outside service.

Keeping those two copies independent is right. For a PDF address, automatically keep the actual PDF rather than trying to turn it into a page snapshot.

The “Saved copies” line and its links are clear. The action could still let me retry or create a missing Internet Archive copy after the automatic local copy exists. With that behaviour, EB-06 is settled.
